stem: What is a redox reaction? Explain with the help of the reaction between copper oxide and hydrogen. Identify the substance oxidised and the substance reduced.
answer_json: {"text":"A redox reaction is one in which both oxidation and reduction take place simultaneously. In the reaction CuO + H₂ → Cu + H₂O, copper oxide (CuO) loses oxygen and is reduced to copper (Cu). Hydrogen (H₂) gains oxygen and is oxidised to water (H₂O). CuO is the oxidising agent as it provides oxygen, and H₂ is the reducing agent as it removes oxygen from CuO."}

answer_json: {"text":"Step 1: Concentration of ore — The ore is crushed and concentrated to remove impurities (gangue). Step 2: Roasting — The concentrated sulphide ore (ZnS) is heated strongly in air to convert it to zinc oxide (ZnO): 2ZnS + 3O₂ → 2ZnO + 2SO₂. Step 3: Reduction — The zinc oxide is reduced to zinc metal using carbon (coke) as a reducing agent: ZnO + C → Zn + CO. stem: Describe the process of nutrition in Amoeba with the help of labelled diagrams.
answer_json: {"text":"Amoeba feeds by the process of holozoic nutrition involving five steps: (1) Ingestion — Amoeba ingests food by forming pseudopodia around the food particle, enclosing it in a food vacuole. (2) Digestion — Enzymes are secreted into the food vacuole and the food is digested. (3) Absorption — The digested nutrients are absorbed into the cytoplasm. (4) Assimilation — The absorbed nutrients are used for energy and growth. (5) Egestion — Undigested food is expelled from the body surface."}
rubric_json: {"marking_scheme":[{"point":"Ingestion with pseudopodia","marks":1},{"point":"Digestion in food vacuole","marks":1},{"point":"Absorption into cytoplasm","marks":1},{"point":"Assimilation for energy/growth","marks":1},{"point":"Egestion from body surface","marks":1}]}
